home.title: Rodrigo López
home.intro: I design and build systems across the boundary between software and hardware — from embedded firmware and electronics to robotics, full-stack applications, Linux infrastructure, and aerospace engineering. This portfolio documents projects that move from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, and physical validation.
home.projects_intro: From Bluetooth-controlled robots and microcontroller firmware to full-stack infrastructure and aerospace systems — each one built the same way: define the problem, understand the interfaces, build a testable architecture, integrate hardware and software, validate the result.
home.certifications_intro: Formal training in networking, network security, and engineering, alongside recognition from the international space community.
home.closing_body: I'm interested in engineering and software work involving embedded systems, robotics, electronics, automation, aerospace, telecommunications, full-stack development, and technical R&D. If you're building a system that combines software with real-world hardware, data, or engineering constraints, I'd like to hear about it.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: Mechatronics and Electronic Engineering at Universidad del Valle de Guatemala, and five roles that have run from aerospace R&D in Boulder, Colorado to CubeSat and digital-fabrication labs in Guatemala City. One through-line: engineering treated as a systems problem — mechanics, electronics, firmware, communications, software architecture and validation understood at the same time, not as separate disciplines handed off to each other.
experience.education: Education: B.S. Mechatronics & Electronic Engineering, Universidad del Valle de Guatemala (2023–present)
experience.focus: Focus: Embedded systems, robotics, electronics, Linux infrastructure, aerospace

roles.org: IAF IPMC Young Professionals Leadership Development Programme
roles.summary: Selected for the programme's 2026 cohort to develop analysis and decision-support methodologies for complex technological projects.
highlights: Analysed large volumes of technical information to identify operational risks and propose monitoring methodologies for distributed systems.
Evaluated artificial intelligence, machine learning, digital twins and predictive analytics for process monitoring and performance-indicator definition.
Built methodologies for modelling information flows, inter-system dependencies and operational resilience across engineering projects.
Co-authored technical documentation on digital tooling for project monitoring and analysis.

roles.summary: Translated client requirements into technical specifications, system architecture and implementation plans for technology products.
highlights: Wrote Python tooling to automate engineering workflows, data analysis and the generation of technical information used during product development.
Worked with multidisciplinary teams on hardware/software interfaces, documenting system behaviour and supporting integration.
Integrated and diagnosed embedded communication interfaces over UART and serial links, using sensors and diagnostic tooling for system validation.
Produced functional specifications, validation procedures, engineering reports and product documentation under a structured development process.

roles.summary: Kept a digital-fabrication lab running — the equipment, the Linux environments behind it, and the students using both.
highlights: Diagnosed calibration, firmware and hardware/software integration faults on digital-fabrication equipment.
Administered Linux-based development environments and embedded systems that the lab equipment depended on.
Wrote technical manuals, operating procedures and troubleshooting guides to raise equipment availability.
Advised students on microcontroller programming, embedded-system integration and application development.
Documented technical incidents and proposed workflow improvements to increase the lab's operational efficiency.

roles.summary: Firmware architecture for CubeSat-class subsystems, from state machines to the protocols between them.
highlights: Designed firmware architecture for CubeSat-type subsystems: state machines, peripheral control, telemetry and operating logic.
Developed firmware proposals for sensor integration, PWM control, H-bridge drivers and serial communication between embedded modules.
Specified inter-subsystem communication interfaces over UART and I²C, documenting the integration contract.
Used Git to manage changes across firmware, technical documentation and hardware/software integration.
Produced software architecture diagrams, interface documentation and test procedures for system integration.

roles.summary: Embedded systems for environmental monitoring and automatic data acquisition during biomedical spaceflight experiments.
highlights: Programmed embedded systems for environmental monitoring and automatic data acquisition during biomedical experiments.
Integrated sensors with data-acquisition platforms for space-research experiments.
Ran functional tests and validation processes on electronic systems ahead of integration.
Documented test procedures, results and hardware/software integration.
